about: Every word the site shows that is not already part of a page, a form, the menus or the media list. Keys are permanent; the text is the shipped default, and a published edit from Connect wins over it. Required text cannot be published empty and must keep every {{placeholder}} its default has; text marked optional disappears from the page when published empty.

page.skip.where: First link on every page, for keyboard users.

header.wordmark.where: The name beside the hand, in the header and the footer.

header.homeSuffix.where: Read aloud after the name in the header link, so it says where the link goes.

header.menu.where: The menu button on a phone.

header.navLabel.where: The main menu's name, read by screen readers.

link.toConnect.where: Read aloud after every link that leaves for Connect.

support.label.where: The crisis-line band's name, read by screen readers. The band's sentence is edited in Site settings.

footer.socialLabel.where: The social links' name, read by screen readers.

footer.legalLabel.where: The privacy and sign-in links' name, read by screen readers.

announce.label.where: The announcement strip's name, read by screen readers.

proto.title.text: Prototype for review — not the live site.
proto.title.where: Strip at the top of the prototype only. Never shown on the published site.

proto.body.text: Event times were copied from badgersupports.org on 19 October 2026 and are not live data. Forms save only to a local test database; nothing is emailed or sent to Connect.
proto.body.where: Second sentence of the prototype strip.

embed.play.where: Button on an Instagram video; pressing it loads Instagram’s player.

embed.notice.text: Playing it loads Instagram, which may set its own cookies.
embed.notice.where: Under the Play button on an Instagram video.

hero.taglineLabel.where: The hero's three-word list, read by screen readers.

hero.photosLabel.where: The hero photos' name, read by screen readers.

hero.pause.where: Button in the corner of the hero's photo circles that stops them drifting.

hero.play.where: The same button once the circles are paused; it starts them drifting again.

schedule.today.where: Tag on today's date in the timetable.

schedule.todayPrefix.where: Read before today's date by screen readers.

schedule.placeLink.where: Link under the usual place in the timetable.

schedule.laterTitle.where: Heading over later events, when the timetable block gives none.

schedule.signup.none.where: Beside an event anyone can walk into.

schedule.dropIn.where: Button beside an event anyone can walk into. Opens the program’s page (peer support groups) or the room’s directions.

schedule.signup.connect.where: Link beside an event that needs a sign-up on Connect.

schedule.signup.link.where: Beside an event that needs a sign-up somewhere else.

schedule.ended.where: Shown on an event once it has finished.

program.upcomingLabel.where: Heading over a program's next dates, read by screen readers, when the block gives none.

strip.prev.where: Button that moves a photo strip back.

strip.next.where: Button that moves a photo strip on.

strip.trackLabel.where: A photo strip's name, read by screen readers. {{title}} is the section heading.

wall.more.where: Button on the Wall of Support, when the block gives none.

involve.closed.where: Tag on a way to get involved whose application form is switched off.

workshops.inWorkshop.where: Above the list of what each workshop covers, beside its preview.

workshops.examples.where: Under the ways a kind of support shows up, in the support-network preview.

mood.error.text: Unable to record that just now. Try again in a minute — nothing was saved.
mood.error.where: When a mood tap could not be saved.

mood.count.one.where: Above the counts, when one person has checked in.

mood.count.other.where: Above the counts, when more than one has.

mood.pageTitle.where: Heading of the page shown after a mood tap without JavaScript.

date.dowLong.0.where: Weekday read aloud with a date.

date.dowLong.1.where: Weekday read aloud with a date.

date.dowLong.2.where: Weekday read aloud with a date.

date.dowLong.5.where: Weekday read aloud with a date.

date.dowLong.6.where: Weekday read aloud with a date.

date.monLong.1.where: Month read aloud with a date.

date.monLong.2.where: Month read aloud with a date.

date.monLong.3.where: Month read aloud with a date.

date.monLong.4.where: Month read aloud with a date.

date.monLong.9.where: Month read aloud with a date.

date.monLong.10.where: Month read aloud with a date.

date.monLong.11.where: Month read aloud with a date.

time.pm.where: After an afternoon or evening time.

form.rule.text: Every question is required unless it says optional.
form.rule.where: Line above the questions of a form that has required questions.

form.optional.where: After the label of a question that can be left empty.

form.other.where: The write-in answer on a question that allows one.

form.otherLabel.where: The write-in box's name, read by screen readers.

form.choose.where: First line of a drop-down list.

form.onlyIf.where: Above a section that only applies after a certain answer. Hidden once JavaScript shows and hides sections itself.

form.or.where: Between two answers in that line.

form.send.where: The button at the end of a form, unless the form names its own.

form.trap.where: A field only automated spam fills in. People never see it.

form.errors.title.where: Heading of the box listing answers that need a look.

form.errors.one.text: One answer needs a look. Your other answers are kept.
form.errors.one.where: In that box, for one answer.

form.errors.many.text: {{n}} answers need a look. Your other answers are kept.
form.errors.many.where: In that box, for more than one.

form.closed.title.where: Heading shown instead of a form that is switched off. The sentence under it is each form's own.

form.elsewhere.go.where: Button on a form's page while the form is still on Google Forms (at launch, until Connect shows submissions). It opens the Google Form.

form.closedNow.title.where: When a form is switched off while someone has it open.

form.closedNow.body.text: Your answers were not sent. They are still on this page if you want to copy them.

form.closedNow.copy.text: Your answers were not sent. Here is what you wrote, so you can keep a copy:
form.closedNow.copy.where: Under that heading, without JavaScript, above the person's own answers.

form.updated.title.text: This form was updated while it was open
form.updated.title.where: When the questions changed while someone had the form open.

form.updated.body.text: Check the answers marked below. The rest of what you wrote is kept.

form.sending.where: While a form is being sent.

form.status.network.text: Unable to send — check your connection and press Send again. Your answers are kept, and sending again will not create a second request.

form.status.rateLimited.text: Unable to send right now — too many requests from this connection. Wait a few minutes, then press Send again. Your answers are kept.
form.status.rateLimited.where: When one connection has sent too many.

form.status.serverError.text: Unable to send — something went wrong on our side. Press Send again in a minute; your answers are kept.

form.done.title.where: Heading after sending, when the form gives none of its own.

form.done.ref.where: After sending. {{ref}} is the submission's reference.

form.error.thisQuestion.where: Stands in for a question's label in an error, if it has none.

form.error.tooLong.text: Shorten your answer to {{max}} characters or fewer.
form.error.tooLong.where: An answer over the length limit.

form.error.emailShape.text: Enter an email address like name@wisc.edu.
form.error.emailShape.where: An email address that cannot be one.

form.error.numberShape.where: A number question with something else in it.

form.error.numberLow.where: A number under the question's minimum.

form.error.numberHigh.where: A number over the question's maximum.

form.error.optionUnknown.text: Choose one of the listed answers.
form.error.optionUnknown.where: An answer that is not one of the choices.

form.error.dateShape.where: A date question with no real date.

form.error.datetimeShape.text: Enter a date and a time.

form.error.confirmNeeded.where: A box that must be ticked.

form.error.other.where: Any other problem with an answer.

team.all.where: Link back to the team page at the top of each person's profile page.

team.classOf.where: After a student's pronouns on their profile page, from the class year in their Connect profile.

team.connectWith.where: The email link on a profile page, shown only when the person chose to publish a contact.

team.more.where: Heading over the other people in the same group, at the foot of a profile page.

team.pageTitle.where: Browser tab and search result title of a profile page.

team.pageDescription.where: Search result description of a profile page.

errors.server.title.where: Heading when the site fails while answering.

errors.server.body.text: Nothing was saved. Try again in a minute. If it keeps happening, email hello@badgersupports.org.

directions.all.where: Link above a room’s name, back to the list of rooms.

directions.map.where: The button on a room’s page that opens its address in a map.

directions.stepsTitle.where: Heading over a room’s numbered steps.

directions.nextHere.where: Heading over the next events held in a room.

directions.arrive.where: End of the route on a room’s directions.

directions.ticket.where: The stub of each room’s ticket on the list of rooms.

directions.pageTitle.where: A room page’s title in the browser tab and in search results.

directions.pageDescription.where: A room page’s summary in search results and link previews.

directions.eventRooms.where: Heading over the rooms events are held in, under the Hub on the list of rooms.

events.calendar.where: On the calendar pill beside Drop in on the next event at the top of a program's page; read by screen readers on the round calendar button on an event card, before the event name. Each opens a calendar file.

events.next.where: Small label over the next event's name at the top of a program's page, when the block gives none.

events.recentTitle.where: Heading over events that have happened, when the event-card block gives none.

events.none.where: Shown in place of event cards when none are coming up.

media.linkAlt.text: A photo from a Badger Supports event.
media.linkAlt.where: Read aloud for a pasted photo link that has no description of its own
